title: Continuity of sections at an inverse limit
statement:
Let $I$ be a directed set and $(X_j,f_{kj})_{j\in I}$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ whose transition morphisms $f_{kj}:X_k\to X_j$ ($k\ge j$) are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], every $X_j$ being quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]; let $X=\varprojlim_jX_j$ with projections $f_j:X\to X_j$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Fix $i\in I$ and an abelian sheaf $F_i$ on $(X_i)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $F_j=f_{ji}^{-1}F_i$ ($j\ge i$) and $F=f_i^{-1}F_i$ be its inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $j_0\ge i$ and let $W_{j_0}\to X_{j_0}$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], an object of $(X_{j_0})_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; put $W_k=W_{j_0}\times_{X_{j_0}}X_k$ ($k\ge j_0$) and $W=W_{j_0}\times_{X_{j_0}}X$ (fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]), objects of $(X_k)_{\Et}$ and $X_{\Et}$. For $k'\ge k\ge j_0$ let $\rho_{k'k}:F_k(W_k)\to F_{k'}(W_{k'})$ be the composite of the unit $\eta_{f_{k'k},F_k}$ of $f_{k'k}^{-1}\dashv f_{k'k,*}$ on sections over $W_k$, which lands in $(f_{k'k}^{-1}F_k)(W_k\times_{X_k}X_{k'})$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], of the composition isomorphism $c_{f_{ki},f_{k'k},F_i}:f_{k'k}^{-1}f_{ki}^{-1}F_i\xrightarrow{\sim}f_{k'i}^{-1}F_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], and of the restriction along the canonical isomorphism $W_{k'}\xrightarrow{\sim}W_k\times_{X_k}X_{k'}$ of iterated fibre products; let $\rho_k:F_k(W_k)\to F(W)$ be defined in the same way from the unit of $f_k^{-1}\dashv f_{k,*}$, the isomorphism $c_{f_{ki},f_k,F_i}:f_k^{-1}f_{ki}^{-1}F_i\xrightarrow{\sim}f_i^{-1}F_i$ and the canonical isomorphism $W\xrightarrow{\sim}W_k\times_{X_k}X$. Then $\rho_{kk}=\mathrm{id}$, $\rho_{k''k'}\circ\rho_{k'k}=\rho_{k''k}$, $\rho_{k'}\circ\rho_{k'k}=\rho_k$, and the induced homomorphism of abelian groups
$$
 \varinjlim_{k\ge j_0}F_k(W_k)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }F(W)
$$
is an isomorphism. In particular (take $j_0=i$, $W_i=X_i$ with the identity, and identify $W_k=X_i\times_{X_i}X_k\cong X_k$, $W\cong X$ canonically)
$$
 \varinjlim_{j\ge i}F_j(X_j)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }F(X).
$$

proof.text: Form E_j = W times_R D_j with maps induced by D and the cone d with apex W times_R c.pt. The projection beta:E -> D and its pullback squares give IsLimit d directly by Mathlib isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected, since a cofiltered category is connected. Pullback stability and qcqs permanence give qcqs stages and affine transitions. Give E its structure maps sigma_j = fst followed by W.hom and Q = fst followed by W.hom at the apex.
Apply globalSections_limit_comparison to E, sigma, d, Q and G. This produces representatives and eventual vanishing for global sections on the base-changed schemes.

Use the explicitly constructed pullbackSectionsEquiv and pullbackSections_comparison to identify each original evaluated push-pull section group with the corresponding global section group and to identify transitions and cone legs.

For a target section t, choose a global representative s of e_P(t), pull it back by e_j inverse, and apply injectivity of e_P and the comparison identity. For a stage section killed at the limit, apply e_P and its zero-preservation, obtain a later-stage global vanishing witness, then apply the comparison identity and injectivity of e_j to return the required zero equality.

proof_origin.place: Theorem Tag 09YQ in degree zero, applied to E_j = W times_R D_j; connected-pullback limit and transfer of representatives/zeros implemented in Lean by P1. The two separate remaining bridges carry the global continuity and single-square comparison arguments.
